fields.label: Rule ID
fields.description: Stable identifier matching a rule in monitoring/rule_registry.py. The evaluation logic lives in version-controlled Python, never in this record -- CLAUDE.md §11 requires deterministic, reviewable pass/fail.

fields.label: Rule Version
fields.description: Set from the registry on each run, so a finding can be traced to the logic version that produced it.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: Records created before this date are not evaluated -- a new rule must not retroactively fault historic records.
